```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("00_setup.R")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis settings
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
STUDY_YEARS <- 2016:2025
EXPECTED_N_HR <- 439L
RESULT_DIR <- path.expand("~/Downloads/inla_results")
dir.create(RESULT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# This file uses the cleaned confirmed-case data and the municipality-year
# population panel produced earlier in the pipeline, but it rebuilds the
# health-region crosswalk itself and does NOT depend on objects from File 11.
if (!exists("Chik_total")) {
  stop("Object 'Chik_total' not found. Run 01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd first.")
}
if (!exists("pop_panel_total")) {
  stop("Object 'pop_panel_total' not found. Run 02_population_panel.R first.")
}
```

## Purpose

Hospitalized case fatality is conditioned on notification, admission thresholds,
and hospital access, all of which may vary geographically. This file therefore
constructs population-denominated severity outcomes at SUS health-region level:

- **deaths per 100,000 population**, and
- **hospitalizations per 100,000 population**.

The analysis covers **2016–2025**, matching the revised study period. This file
is descriptive and contains no new INLA model. It is self-contained with respect
to the SUS health-region crosswalk and does not require File 11 to be run first.

## SUS health-region crosswalk

```{r health-region-crosswalk}
# Use the current 2025 SUS health-region definition, matching the convention
# used in the shared-component analysis.
health_regions_sf <- geobr::read_health_region(
  year = 2025,
  showProgress = FALSE
) %>%
  sf::st_make_valid()

required_hr_cols <- c("code_muni", "code_health_region")
missing_hr_cols <- setdiff(required_hr_cols, names(health_regions_sf))
if (length(missing_hr_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Expected geobr health-region columns are missing: ",
    paste(missing_hr_cols, collapse = ", "),
    ". Available columns: ",
    paste(names(health_regions_sf), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

muni_to_health_region <- health_regions_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      width = 6,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    ),
    code_health_region = as.character(code_health_region)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# Every municipality should map to only one health region.
muni_map_check <- muni_to_health_region %>%
  count(code_muni, name = "n_hr") %>%
  filter(n_hr != 1)

if (nrow(muni_map_check) > 0) {
  stop("At least one municipality maps to multiple health regions.")
}

hr_levels <- sort(unique(muni_to_health_region$code_health_region))

cat("Municipalities in health-region crosswalk:",
    n_distinct(muni_to_health_region$code_muni), "\n")
cat("Distinct SUS health regions:", length(hr_levels), "\n")

if (length(hr_levels) != EXPECTED_N_HR) {
  stop(
    "Expected ", EXPECTED_N_HR,
    " SUS health regions but found ", length(hr_levels), "."
  )
}
```

## Confirmed cases, deaths, and hospitalizations

```{r severity-counts}
chik_severity_base <- Chik_total %>%
  filter(
    CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13),
    !is.na(DT_SIN_PRI)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(format(as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI), "%Y")),
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(
      substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 6),
      width = 6,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    ),
    is_death = as.character(EVOLUCAO) == "2",
    is_hosp  = as.character(HOSPITALIZ) == "1"
  ) %>%
  filter(year %in% STUDY_YEARS) %>%
  left_join(muni_to_health_region, by = "code_muni")

# Do not silently drop records that fail the geography crosswalk.
geo_audit <- chik_severity_base %>%
  summarise(
    n_confirmed = n(),
    n_unmapped = sum(is.na(code_health_region)),
    deaths_total = sum(is_death, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_unmapped = sum(is_death & is.na(code_health_region), na.rm = TRUE),
    hosp_total = sum(is_hosp, na.rm = TRUE),
    hosp_unmapped = sum(is_hosp & is.na(code_health_region), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(geo_audit)

if (geo_audit$n_unmapped > 0) {
  stop(
    "There are ", geo_audit$n_unmapped,
    " confirmed records without a SUS health-region mapping. Resolve before continuing."
  )
}

chik_severity_base <- chik_severity_base %>%
  filter(!is.na(code_health_region))

deaths_by_hr_year <- chik_severity_base %>%
  filter(is_death) %>%
  count(code_health_region, year, name = "deaths")

hosp_by_hr_year <- chik_severity_base %>%
  filter(is_hosp) %>%
  count(code_health_region, year, name = "hospitalizations")

cat("Health-region-years with at least one death:",
    nrow(deaths_by_hr_year), "\n")
cat("Health-region-years with at least one hospitalization:",
    nrow(hosp_by_hr_year), "\n")
```

## Population by health-region-year

```{r severity-population}
pop_hr_year <- pop_panel_total %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      width = 6,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(year %in% STUDY_YEARS) %>%
  left_join(muni_to_health_region, by = "code_muni")

pop_geo_audit <- pop_hr_year %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_unmapped = sum(is.na(code_health_region)),
    n_missing_pop = sum(is.na(total_pop)),
    n_nonpositive_pop = sum(total_pop <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(pop_geo_audit)

if (pop_geo_audit$n_unmapped > 0 ||
    pop_geo_audit$n_missing_pop > 0 ||
    pop_geo_audit$n_nonpositive_pop > 0) {
  stop("Population geography/denominator audit failed.")
}

pop_hr_year <- pop_hr_year %>%
  group_by(code_health_region, year) %>%
  summarise(pop = sum(total_pop), .groups = "drop")
```

## Build the complete severity surface

```{r severity-surface}
severity_surface <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  code_health_region = hr_levels,
  year = STUDY_YEARS
) %>%
  left_join(deaths_by_hr_year,
            by = c("code_health_region", "year")) %>%
  left_join(hosp_by_hr_year,
            by = c("code_health_region", "year")) %>%
  left_join(pop_hr_year,
            by = c("code_health_region", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    deaths = tidyr::replace_na(deaths, 0L),
    hospitalizations = tidyr::replace_na(hospitalizations, 0L)
  )

EXPECTED_ROWS <- EXPECTED_N_HR * length(STUDY_YEARS)

surface_audit <- severity_surface %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_regions = n_distinct(code_health_region),
    n_years = n_distinct(year),
    n_missing_pop = sum(is.na(pop)),
    n_nonpositive_pop = sum(pop <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_deaths = sum(deaths),
    total_hospitalizations = sum(hospitalizations)
  )

print(surface_audit)

stopifnot(
  nrow(severity_surface) == EXPECTED_ROWS,
  n_distinct(severity_surface$code_health_region) == EXPECTED_N_HR,
  identical(sort(unique(severity_surface$year)), STUDY_YEARS),
  surface_audit$n_missing_pop == 0,
  surface_audit$n_nonpositive_pop == 0,
  !anyDuplicated(severity_surface[c("code_health_region", "year")]),
  surface_audit$total_deaths == sum(chik_severity_base$is_death, na.rm = TRUE),
  surface_audit$total_hospitalizations == sum(chik_severity_base$is_hosp, na.rm = TRUE)
)

severity_surface <- severity_surface %>%
  mutate(
    deaths_per_100k = 1e5 * deaths / pop,
    hosp_per_100k   = 1e5 * hospitalizations / pop
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, code_health_region)

cat("\nHealth-region-years in severity surface:",
    nrow(severity_surface),
    "(expected", EXPECTED_ROWS, ")\n")

cat("\n=== Deaths per 100,000 ===\n")
print(summary(severity_surface$deaths_per_100k))

cat("\n=== Hospitalizations per 100,000 ===\n")
print(summary(severity_surface$hosp_per_100k))
```

## Descriptive association between the two severity outcomes

These correlations are descriptive checks only. They do not constitute a
causal analysis or a formal test of the case-death spatial concordance addressed
by the shared-component model in File 11.

```{r severity-correlations}
severity_correlations <- tibble(
  period = c("2016-2025", "2024-2025"),
  pearson = c(
    cor(
      severity_surface$deaths_per_100k,
      severity_surface$hosp_per_100k,
      method = "pearson",
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    severity_surface %>%
      filter(year %in% 2024:2025) %>%
      summarise(
        r = cor(
          deaths_per_100k,
          hosp_per_100k,
          method = "pearson",
          use = "complete.obs"
        )
      ) %>%
      pull(r)
  ),
  spearman = c(
    cor(
      severity_surface$deaths_per_100k,
      severity_surface$hosp_per_100k,
      method = "spearman",
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    severity_surface %>%
      filter(year %in% 2024:2025) %>%
      summarise(
        rho = cor(
          deaths_per_100k,
          hosp_per_100k,
          method = "spearman",
          use = "complete.obs"
        )
      ) %>%
      pull(rho)
  )
)

print(severity_correlations)

n_hosp_no_death <- severity_surface %>%
  filter(hospitalizations > 50, deaths == 0) %>%
  nrow()

cat(
  "Health-region-years with >50 hospitalizations but 0 deaths:",
  n_hosp_no_death,
  "\n"
)
```

## 2024–2025 summary

```{r recent-summary}
severity_recent_summary <- severity_surface %>%
  filter(year %in% 2024:2025) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    health_regions = n(),
    population = sum(pop),
    deaths = sum(deaths),
    hospitalizations = sum(hospitalizations),
    deaths_per_100k_national = 1e5 * deaths / population,
    hosp_per_100k_national = 1e5 * hospitalizations / population,
    median_hr_deaths_per_100k = median(deaths_per_100k),
    median_hr_hosp_per_100k = median(hosp_per_100k),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(severity_recent_summary)
```

## Save outputs

```{r save-severity-surface}
severity_rds <- file.path(
  RESULT_DIR,
  "severity_surface_2016_2025.rds"
)
severity_csv <- file.path(
  RESULT_DIR,
  "severity_surface_2016_2025.csv"
)
cor_csv <- file.path(
  RESULT_DIR,
  "severity_correlations_2016_2025.csv"
)
recent_csv <- file.path(
  RESULT_DIR,
  "severity_2024_2025_summary.csv"
)

saveRDS(severity_surface, severity_rds)
readr::write_csv(severity_surface, severity_csv)
readr::write_csv(severity_correlations, cor_csv)
readr::write_csv(severity_recent_summary, recent_csv)

cat("Saved:\n")
cat(" -", severity_rds, "\n")
cat(" -", severity_csv, "\n")
cat(" -", cor_csv, "\n")
cat(" -", recent_csv, "\n")
```

## Interpretation and downstream role

`severity_surface` is the formal **population-denominated geographic severity
surface** for the revised 2016–2025 analysis. It supports description of where
severe chikungunya outcomes were concentrated and provides a rate-based severity
counterpart to the reported-case geography.

It should **not** be described as the direct input to the municipality-level
expected-burden metric in File 13. File 13 constructs its age-weighted severity
vulnerability from municipality age composition and observed age-specific
mortality risk; the present file is a complementary geographic severity analysis.
